belongs_elsewhere: This fits a plain command or chat alert. Set it up there instead
command_exists: A command already uses this name. Pick another name, or edit that command
alert_exists: This chat alert already has its own message. Edit that alert instead
uses_token: Automations have no use count. Remove {count} or {uses} from the message
perm_required: Limit this command to a role that may run this action
delay_budget: Waits add up to more than 60 seconds
